summary: tools/release prepare <version> makes the brief's checks in order (version, module major, retraction, after latest tag, tag absent locally and on origin, main/clean/origin-equal after fetch, [[check]]s, claude plugin validate plugin), refusing before any write; --dry-run makes them all and prints what it would do.
verified: vloop task gate T4 exited 0 and printed gate T4: ok; go test ./tools/... passes.
notes: prepare.go: prepareChecks returns a refusal and writes nothing (its only side effect is the fetch of origin/main). After the checks pass, non-dry-run prints a placeholder line; T5 replaces it with branch, commit, push and PR. A failed check or validate prints its output on stderr before the release: line. Checks run via sh -c in the repo root (pwsh on Windows) from config.Checks.
